instruction: Like all the songs and albums in my Spotify song and album library, respectively, that I have not liked yet.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. The library contents are unknown up front, so the problem uses placeholder entities: three library songs and three library albums, one of each already liked (song-3, album-3) to capture the 'not liked yet' filter; at runtime there is one like_song/like_album call per unliked library item (paginate show_song_library/show_liked_songs and show_album_library/show_liked_albums fully). Because quantified effects are disallowed, listing the library and the liked items is modeled with nullary knowledge predicates (song-library-listed, liked-songs-listed, album-library-listed, liked-albums-listed) combined with static in-song-library/in-album-library facts; like actions require both listings and (not (liked-...)) so already-liked items are never re-liked and nothing outside the library is touched (matching the evaluation, which only allows new SongLike/AlbumLike rows for library items). supervisor-complete-task takes the library records as non-API parameters with pairwise inequality so its precondition is exactly the conjunction of the goal facts; (task-completed) is produced only there and blocks every other action. Login username is the supervisor's email; password comes from show_account_passwords, token from spotify.login. No answer is passed to complete_task.

plan: (supervisor-complete-task song-1 song-2 song-3 album-1 album-2 album-3)
